name: Sangolli Rayanna
tagline: The fearless warrior who never surrendered
story: Sangolli Rayanna was a military chief of Kittur and a brave freedom fighter who fiercely resisted British rule. Born in Sangolli village of Dharwad, he was the commander of Kittur Chennamma's forces. After Chennamma's capture, he continued the revolt alone, destroying British camps and supply lines. He was eventually captured and hanged by the British in 1831. He remains one of Karnataka's greatest heroes of resistance.
storyKannada: ಸಂಗೊಳ್ಳಿ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ಸೇನಾಧಿಪತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ತೀವ್ರವಾಗಿ ವಿರೋಧಿಸಿದ ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರ.

name: Kittur Chennamma
tagline: The queen who fought the British before the 1857 revolt
story: Kittur Chennamma was the queen of Kittur who led an armed uprising against the British East India Company in 1824 — more than 30 years before the 1857 revolt. When the British tried to annex her kingdom, she took up arms and defeated them in the first battle. She was eventually captured and died in prison in 1829, but her courage inspired generations of freedom fighters across India.
storyKannada: ಕಿತ್ತೂರು ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಕಿತ್ತೂರಿನ ರಾಣಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, 1824 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಈಸ್ಟ್ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕಂಪನಿ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಸಶಸ್ತ್ರ ದಂಗೆಯನ್ನು ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಿದರು.

name: Akka Mahadevi
tagline: The mystic poet who chose God over a kingdom
story: Akka Mahadevi was a 12th century Kannada poet and Veerashaiva saint who became one of the earliest voices for spiritual equality. Born in Udutadi, Shivamogga, she rejected the marriage to King Kausika and devoted her life to Lord Shiva. Her Vachanas speak of love, freedom, and devotion in simple yet powerful words. She walked away from worldly life and became a symbol of spiritual courage.
storyKannada: ಅಕ್ಕ ಮಹಾದೇವಿ 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕವಿ ಮತ್ತು ವೀರಶೈವ ಸಂತರಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಸಮಾನತೆಗಾಗಿ ಮೊದಲ ಧ್ವನಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಾದರು.

name: Kuvempu
tagline: The poet who gave Karnataka its anthem
story: Kuppali Venkatappa Puttappa, known as Kuvempu, was one of Karnataka's greatest literary figures. Born in Kuppali, Chikkamagaluru, he wrote the beloved poem 'Jaya Bharata Jananiya Tanujate' which became the Karnataka state anthem. He was the first Kannada writer to receive the Jnanpith Award and was honoured with the title Rashtrakavi. His works celebrate nature, humanity, and the spirit of Karnataka's hills and forests.
storyKannada: ಕುಪ್ಪಳಿ ವೆಂಕಟಪ್ಪ ಪುಟ್ಟಪ್ಪ, ಕುವೆಂಪು ಎಂದು ಪರಿಚಿತರಾದ ಅವರು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು.

name: Basavanna
tagline: The saint who fought caste 900 years ago
taglineKannada: 900 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಜಾತಿ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ಸಂತ
story: Basavanna was a 12th century philosopher, social reformer, and statesman born in Bagewadi, Bagalkot. He founded the Lingayat movement and fought fiercely against the caste system, untouchability, and gender discrimination. He established the Anubhava Mantapa, one of the world's first democratic spiritual parliaments, where people of all castes and genders could speak freely.
storyKannada: ಬಸವಣ್ಣ 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನಿ, ಸಮಾಜ ಸುಧಾರಕ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜಕಾರಣಿ, ಬಾಗಲಕೋಟೆಯ ಬಾಗೇವಾಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರು.

name: Nadaprabhu Kempegowda
tagline: The visionary who built the city of Bengaluru
story: Hiriya Kempegowda, also known as Nadaprabhu Kempegowda, was a chieftain under the Vijayanagara Empire who founded the city of Bengaluru in 1537. Born in Yelahanka, he planned the city with a vision for its future, building tanks, temples, and roads. He constructed four watchtowers at the city's boundaries to mark its planned expansion. Today, Bengaluru is one of the world's major technology hubs.
storyKannada: ಹಿರಿಯ ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ, ನಾಡಪ್ರಭು ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ ಎಂದೂ ಪರಿಚಿತರಾದ ಅವರು 1537 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ನಗರವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದರು.

name: Onake Obavva
tagline: The woman who held a fort with just a pestle
taglineKannada: ಒಂದೇ ಒನಕೆಯಿಂದ ಕೋಟೆ ಕಾದ ವೀರ ಮಹಿಳೆ
story: Onake Obavva was a brave woman from Chitradurga who single-handedly defended the Chitradurga fort against Hyder Ali's soldiers in the 18th century. While her husband was away, she discovered enemy soldiers sneaking in through a small hole in the fort wall. Using only her onake — a wooden pestle — she killed the soldiers one by one as they entered. She is celebrated as one of Karnataka's most iconic symbols of women's bravery.
storyKannada: ಒನಕೆ ಒಬವ್ವ ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗದ ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ಮಹಿಳೆ, 18ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೈದರ್ ಅಲಿಯ ಸೈನಿಕರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗ ಕೋಟೆಯನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿದರು.

name: Tippu Sultan
tagline: The Tiger of Mysore who died defending his kingdom
taglineKannada: ತನ್ನ ರಾಜ್ಯ ರಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಹೋರಾಡಿ ಮಡಿದ ಮೈಸೂರು ಹುಲಿ
story: Tippu Sultan, known as the Tiger of Mysore, was one of the most formidable opponents of British colonial rule in India. He ruled the Kingdom of Mysore and introduced many military innovations including rocket artillery. He fought four fierce Anglo-Mysore wars and died in battle in 1799 defending his capital Srirangapatna.
storyKannada: ಮೈಸೂರು ಹುಲಿ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಚಿತರಾದ ಟಿಪ್ಪು ಸುಲ್ತಾನ್ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ವಸಾಹತು ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಭಯಂಕರ ವಿರೋಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
tagline: The architect of the Indian Constitution
story: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar was the chief architect of the Indian Constitution and a fierce champion of rights for Dalits and marginalized communities. Despite facing extreme caste discrimination, he earned multiple doctorates from prestigious universities. He founded several organizations to fight for social justice and converted to Buddhism in 1956.
storyKannada: ಡಾ. ಬಿ. ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಭಾರತದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಮತ್ತು ದಲಿತರು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಚಿನ ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ತೀವ್ರ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Allama Prabhu
tagline: The philosopher poet who questioned everything
story: Allama Prabhu was a 12th century mystic poet and Veerashaiva saint born in Balligave, Shivamogga. He was the president of the Anubhava Mantapa, the spiritual parliament founded by Basavanna. His Vachanas are celebrated for their deep philosophical questioning of ego, religion, and the nature of the divine.
storyKannada: ಅಲ್ಲಮ ಪ್ರಭು 12ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಅತೀಂದ್ರಿಯ ಕವಿ ಮತ್ತು ವೀರಶೈವ ಸಂತರಾಗಿದ್ದು ಶಿವಮೊಗ್ಗದ ಬಳ್ಳಿಗಾವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರು.

name: Rani Abbakka Chowta
tagline: The fearless queen who defeated the Portuguese
story: Rani Abbakka Chowta was the queen of Ullal near Mangaluru and one of India's first female freedom fighters. In the 16th century, she fiercely resisted Portuguese colonial attempts to capture her kingdom. She successfully repelled multiple Portuguese invasions. She is celebrated as Abhaya Rani — the fearless queen.
storyKannada: ರಾಣಿ ಅಬ್ಬಕ್ಕ ಚೌಟ ಮಂಗಳೂರು ಬಳಿಯ ಉಳ್ಳಾಲದ ರಾಣಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ಭಾರತದ ಮೊದಲ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: Vishwamanava Kuvempu
tagline: The universal human who transcended religion
story: Kuvempu's concept of Vishwamanava — the Universal Human — remains one of Karnataka's most powerful philosophical contributions. He believed that humans must transcend the boundaries of caste, religion, language, and nation to become truly universal beings. His novels like Kanooru Heggadithi are masterpieces of Kannada literature.
storyKannada: ಕುವೆಂಪು ಅವರ ವಿಶ್ವಮಾನವ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ತಾತ್ವಿಕ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.

name: Narayana Guru
tagline: One caste, one religion, one God for humanity
taglineKannada: ಮಾನವ ಜಾತಿ ಒಂದೇ, ಧರ್ಮ ಒಂದೇ, ದೇವರು ಒಂದೇ
story: Narayana Guru was a saint and social reformer who had a profound influence on coastal Karnataka. His philosophy of one caste, one religion, one God for humanity challenged the rigid caste hierarchy of his time. He established temples that were open to all castes and fought against untouchability.
storyKannada: ನಾರಾಯಣ ಗುರು ಕರಾವಳಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರಿದ ಸಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜ ಸುಧಾರಕರಾಗಿದ್ದರು.

name: King Vishnuvardhana
tagline: The warrior king who built the Belur temple
story: King Vishnuvardhana of the Hoysala dynasty commissioned the famous Chennakeshava temple at Belur in Hassan district in 1117 CE. The temple is a marvel of Hoysala architecture with intricate carvings that took over a century to complete. The Belur temple remains one of Karnataka's most treasured heritage sites.
storyKannada: ಹೊಯ್ಸಳ ರಾಜವಂಶದ ರಾಜ ವಿಷ್ಣುವರ್ಧನ 1117 ಸಿಇಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಸನ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಬೇಲೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಚೆನ್ನಕೇಶವ ದೇವಾಲಯವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದರು.

name: S. L. Bhyrappa
tagline: The greatest living Kannada novelist
story: S. L. Bhyrappa is one of the most celebrated Kannada novelists of the 20th and 21st centuries. Born in Solige, Hassan district, he has written over 24 novels exploring deep philosophical, historical, and social themes. His works like Vamshavriksha, Parva, and Aavarana have been translated into multiple Indian languages.
storyKannada: ಎಸ್. ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ 20 ಮತ್ತು 21ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಕಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು.

name: Hyder Ali
tagline: The iron-willed ruler who modernized Mysore
story: Hyder Ali was the Sultan of Mysore who rose from a soldier to become one of the most powerful rulers in South India. Born in Kolar, he modernized the Mysore army with French military techniques and was the first Indian ruler to use rocket artillery in warfare. He fought fiercely against the British and Marathas to protect his kingdom. His son Tippu Sultan continued his legacy of resistance against colonial rule.
storyKannada: ಹೈದರ್ ಅಲಿ ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಸುಲ್ತಾನರಾಗಿದ್ದು ಒಬ್ಬ ಸೈನಿಕನಿಂದ ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ಆಡಳಿತಗಾರರಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದರು. ಕೋಲಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಅವರು ಫ್ರೆಂಚ್ ಮಿಲಿಟರಿ ತಂತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ಮೈಸೂರು ಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಆಧುನೀಕರಿಸಿದರು.

name: Shishunala Sharifa
tagline: The saint poet who united Hindus and Muslims through song
taglineKannada: ಹಾಡಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಿಂದೂ-ಮುಸ್ಲಿಮರನ್ನು ಒಂದುಗೂಡಿಸಿದ ಸಂತ ಕವಿ
story: Shishunala Sharifa was a 19th century saint poet from Shishunala village in Haveri district. He wrote beautiful Kannada poems called Tathvapadas that celebrated the unity of all religions. His guru was a Hindu saint named Govinda Bhatta, and together they showed that love for God transcends all religious boundaries. His songs are still sung at festivals across Karnataka and promote communal harmony.
storyKannada: ಶಿಶುನಾಳ ಶರೀಫ 19ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಸಂತ ಕವಿ, ಹಾವೇರಿ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಶಿಶುನಾಳ ಗ್ರಾಮದಿಂದ ಬಂದವರು. ಅವರು ಎಲ್ಲ ಧರ್ಮಗಳ ಏಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಆಚರಿಸುವ ಸುಂದರ ಕನ್ನಡ ತತ್ವಪದಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದರು.

name: Keladi Chennamma
tagline: The queen who sheltered Rajaram against Aurangzeb
taglineKannada: ಔರಂಗಜೇಬ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ರಾಜಾರಾಮನಿಗೆ ಆಶ್ರಯ ನೀಡಿದ ರಾಣಿ
story: Keladi Chennamma was the queen of Keladi kingdom in Shivamogga who bravely sheltered Rajaram, son of Chhatrapati Shivaji, when he was fleeing from Aurangzeb's army. Despite pressure from the Mughal emperor, she refused to surrender him and stood firm in her decision. She was an able administrator and a courageous ruler who expanded the Keladi kingdom and maintained its independence.
storyKannada: ಕೆಳದಿ ಚೆನ್ನಮ್ಮ ಶಿವಮೊಗ್ಗದ ಕೆಳದಿ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ರಾಣಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಔರಂಗಜೇಬನ ಸೈನ್ಯದಿಂದ ಪಲಾಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಛತ್ರಪತಿ ಶಿವಾಜಿಯ ಮಗ ರಾಜಾರಾಮನಿಗೆ ಧೈರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಆಶ್ರಯ ನೀಡಿದರು.

name: Gopal Krishna Gokhale
tagline: Gandhi's political guru and champion of education
taglineKannada: ಗಾಂಧಿಯ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಗುರು ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಕ
story: Gopal Krishna Gokhale had deep connections to Belagavi where the Indian National Congress held its famous 1924 session chaired by Mahatma Gandhi. He was one of the most respected leaders of the Indian independence movement and Mahatma Gandhi's political mentor. He founded the Servants of India Society to train people for public service and fought tirelessly for education, civil rights, and social reform through constitutional means.
storyKannada: ಗೋಪಾಲ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಗೋಖಲೆ ಬೆಳಗಾವಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದರು, ಅಲ್ಲಿ 1924ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಾತ್ಮಾ ಗಾಂಧಿ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಅಧಿವೇಶನ ನಡೆಯಿತು.

name: Purandaradasa
tagline: The father of Carnatic music who sang for the common people
taglineKannada: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಜನರಿಗಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸಂಗೀತದ ಪಿತಾಮಹ
story: Purandaradasa is celebrated as the father of Carnatic music. Born into a wealthy merchant family in Vijayanagara, he gave up all his wealth after a spiritual awakening and became a devoted saint-composer. He composed over 475,000 songs in Kannada and Sanskrit, of which about 1,000 survive today. He systematized the teaching of Carnatic music and his compositions are still used to teach music across South India.
storyKannada: ಪುರಂದರದಾಸ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸಂಗೀತದ ಪಿತಾಮಹ ಎಂದು ಆಚರಿಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವಿಜಯನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಅವರು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಜಾಗೃತಿಯ ನಂತರ ತಮ್ಮ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನು ತ್ಯಜಿಸಿ ಭಕ್ತ ಸಂತ-ಸಂಯೋಜಕರಾದರು.
